page_title: Thaw: the open source menu bar manager for macOS

summary.name: Thaw
summary.one_liner: Thaw is an open source menu bar manager and launcher for macOS that hides, reveals, and organizes menu bar items.
use_cases: reveal hidden items on hover or click
keep menu bar tidy on a MacBook notch
switch menu bar setups per display, Space, or Focus
present without menu bar clutter using Zen Mode
script menu bar actions with thaw:// links
summary.what_it_does: Thaw hides menu bar items into a hidden section and brings them back by click, hover, scroll, or shortcut. It includes keyboard search and letter shortcuts to find and open items, including hidden ones. Groups, folders, and saved profiles let users organize items and switch whole setups, optionally bound to a display, Space, or Focus. Appearance options cover bar shape, glass, border, shadow, wallpaper-based gradient tint, and rounded screen corners. The page also lists Raycast, Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight, and Control Center integrations and a privacy pane showing screen reads and network calls.
notable: Open source, with a free menu bar app and a published security posture (SLSA build level 3, OpenSSF Gold badge)
Made for the notch: shows items hidden under the MacBook notch in a separate bar
Profiles that can bind to displays, Spaces, or Focus modes, with a preview of changes
Scriptable through thaw:// links and integrations with Raycast, Shortcuts, and Siri
caveats: Requires Accessibility permission to move menu bar items; Screen Recording is optional for live previews and wallpaper tint
Some features are only in Thaw 3, not Thaw 2 (the stable release named on the page)
